sources.publisher: Thailand International Cooperation Agency (TICA), Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Thailand
sources.note: Courses for TIPP 2026: the official list of all 22 courses with theme, organizer, duration and closing date (page updated 5 February 2026); course detail sheets linked from the list.

sources.publisher: Thailand International Cooperation Agency (TICA), Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Thailand

subject_rule: Limited: awardees choose one of the 22 listed courses (21 master's and one diploma) at Thai universities, grouped in six themes; they may not change the programme topic or study plan.

programmes.name: Master of Arts Program in Science for Sustainable Local Development
programmes.detail: No. 1 of the TICA 2026 course list. Theme: SEP for SDGs. Duration on the list: 2 Years. Closing date on the list: 23 February 2026. 2 years (June 2026 to May 2028). Entry: a bachelor's degree in any field, under the university's graduate rules. Documents named: application form with medical report, transcript, recommendation letter, English test result.

programmes.name: Master of Science Program in Integrative Biosciences and Innovation (Postharvest) (International Program)
programmes.institution: King Mongkut's University of Technology Thonburi (KMUTT)
programmes.detail: No. 2 of the TICA 2026 course list. Theme: Agriculture and Food Security. Duration on the list: 2 Years. Closing date on the list: 23 February 2026. 2 years (August 2026 to December 2028). Entry: a bachelor's degree in biochemical technology, biotechnology, agricultural or other science, or an equivalent background approved by the committee; English proficiency under KMUTT rules. Documents named: application form, transcript, CV, physical and mental health certificates (not over 3 months old), statement of academic background, study plan statement, recommendation letter with institution seal, English test.

programmes.name: Master of Science in Organic Agriculture Management and Innovative Agricultural Products (International Program)
programmes.detail: No. 3 of the TICA 2026 course list. Theme: Agriculture and Food Security. Duration on the list: 2 Years. Closing date on the list: 23 February 2026. 2 years (June 2026 to March 2028). Entry: a bachelor's degree in any discipline or equivalent, under the university's rules; international applicants must be approved by the instructor in charge.

programmes.name: Master of Science Program in Veterinary Public Health (International Program)
programmes.detail: No. 4 of the TICA 2026 course list. Theme: Agriculture and Food Security. Duration on the list: 2 Years. Closing date on the list: 23 February 2026. 2 years (June 2026 to May 2028). Entry: a bachelor's degree in veterinary science or equivalent; other related degrees are considered by the programme committee. English proof dated within 2 years, for example TOEFL iBT 69, IELTS 5.5 or CMU-eTEGS 65.

programmes.name: Master of Science program in Agriculture Research and Development (International Program) (Kamphaeng Saen Campus)
programmes.detail: No. 5 of the TICA 2026 course list. Theme: Agriculture and Food Security. Duration on the list: 2 Years. Closing date on the list: 23 February 2026. 2 years, 4 semesters (August 2026 to July 2028). Documents named: application form, bachelor's certificate and transcript showing the graduation date, CV, a conceptual research proposal, recommendation letter.

programmes.name: Master of Science Program in Health, Environment and Safety
programmes.detail: No. 6 of the TICA 2026 course list. Theme: Climate Resilience. Duration on the list: 2 Years. Closing date on the list: 23 February 2026. 2 years (May 2026 to April 2028). Entry: a bachelor's degree in science, engineering, technology or health science in a related field with a final GPAX of at least 2.75, or at least 3 years of related work experience; other fields considered by the committee. Documents named: application form and medical report, transcripts and degree certificate, English test results (not older than 2 years), passport copy, two recommendation letters, research proposal, 1-inch photo.

notes: Recorded all 22 courses the TICA list prints: 21 master's programmes and 1 diploma. The source states 22 courses (21 master's and 1 diploma) and the count matches.

Course names are as printed on the TICA list; the list names the organizer 'Mae Jo University' where other pages say Maejo University. The seventh theme named on the overview page (Science, Technology and Innovation for Development) has no course in the 2026 list.
The list is for the 2026 round (applications closed 23 February 2026); the page address says 2027 but the content is the 2026 course list.
not_stated: Teaching language for each course on the list page (many course titles say International Program).
fetch_problems: Five course detail sheets (Mahidol Environmental and Water Resources Engineering, Naresuan Smart Grid Technology, Chiang Mai Mental Health, Mahidol Primary Health Care Management and the Institute of Dermatology diploma) are scanned images and could not be read; their entries rely on the TICA course list.
